# bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_fqdns (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing FQDN ETL Filters.

The FQDN ETL Filter object filters Cloud Data Connector (CDC) flow data by fully qualified domain name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get CDC ETL FQDN Filters filtered by an attribute
data "bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_fqdns" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_etl_filter_fqdn"
  }
}

# Get CDC ETL FQDN Filters filtered by tag
data "bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_fqdns" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Get all CDC ETL FQDN Filters
data "bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_fqdns" "example_all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The list of FQDN ETL Filters matching the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `data` (List of String) The list of FQDNs to filter on.
- `name` (String) The name of the FQDN ETL filter.

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of the FQDN ETL filter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the FQDN ETL filter is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `filter_source` (String) The source the FQDN ETL filter applies to. Allowed values:
  * _SOURCE_DEFAULT_
  * _SOURCE_INGRESS_

Defaults to _SOURCE_DEFAULT_.
- `ingress_policy_action` (String) The ingress policy action of the FQDN ETL filter.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the FQDN ETL filter.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the FQDN ETL filter, including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
